trap.label: step up to
trap.wrong: He stepped up the challenge when the manager fell ill.
trap.right: He stepped up to the challenge when the manager fell ill.
trap.why: Em português “assumir o desafio” não pede preposição. Em inglês step up exige to antes do desafio.

fix.wrong: They stepped on the security after the leak.
fix.right: They stepped up the security after the leak.

fix.wrong: The veteran stepped up the challenge.
fix.right: The veteran stepped up to the challenge.

fix.wrong: They stepped up efforts to listen carefuly.
fix.right: They stepped up efforts to listen carefully.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com step up: “The veteran assumed the role when needed.”
rewrite.answer: The veteran stepped up when needed.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com step up efforts: “We intensify our efforts.”
Reescreva no passado: “She steps up to the challenge.”
rewrite.answer: She stepped up to the challenge.
